title: Potential Lateral Movement After External Scan
id: <new-rule-id>
description: 'Detects successful authentications within 24 hours of external network scans targeting the same host'
logsource:
  category: authentication
  product: windows
detection:
  selection1:
    EventID: 4624
  selection2:
    _ip: <target_ip>
    | network_scan_event
    | where src_ip == <scanning_ip>
    | within 24h
  condition: selection1 && selection2
level: high
